display_long_description:
Ambisonic Playground is a VR sound laboratory where you can walk through real ambisonic recordings and explore how spatial audio behaves inside a 3D environment.
This app is designed for sound designers, VR developers, students, and audio enthusiasts who want hands-on insight into ambisonic recording techniques, spatialisation, and best practices for VR.

Step into multiple test environments and compare the differences between first-order ambisonics, stereo, and mono recordings captured using professional equipment. Move through overlapping audio zones, watch how ambisonic fields change with head tracking, and learn why certain spatial audio techniques work better in specific VR situations.

What You Can Explore

Experience true ambisonic recordings (FOA / AmbiX) captured with a Rode NT-SF1

Compare ambisonic, stereo, and mono ambiences in real time

Understand 3DoF limitations and how sound reacts when the player moves

Walk through single-zone, dual-zone, and multi-zone ambisonic setups

Discover best practices for fading between ambisonic regions

Learn when to use ambisonics and when mono spatialised sources work better

Experiment freely using a simple in-VR audio toggle menu

Ambisonic Playground is an interactive testbed that demonstrates how spatial audio recording, implementation, and zone-based mixing behave in VR.
Whether you’re studying sound design or simply curious about immersive audio, this experience offers a clear, hands-on understanding of ambisonics.
